Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 23

“For if I did not engage tirelessly in action, people would follow my path in every way, Partha.”

The reasoning behind the divine example. Krishna acts because withdrawal, from someone in his position, would itself be an instruction — and would be followed.
